newsitem.title: UK: Future Integrated Telephony debuts on AIM.
newsitem.headline: Future Integrated Telephony debuts on AIM.

text.p: Shares in Future Integrated Telephony Plc, a telephone systems provider, set a premium on their first day of trading on London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Wednesday.

The shares were quoted at 123-1/2p by 1000 GMT, although no trade was registered in the stock. They were placed at 115p, valuing the company at 12.77 million stg and raising 3.20 million stg net, in an issue sponsored by Williams de Broe.
"The market reception to the issue was extremely good, with more people looking for shares than there were available," said a company spokesman.
The proceeds of the issue will be used to increase the company's working capital and to purchase, refurbish and equip new premises.
